subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acme.com>, Sara Kim <sara.kim@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits extension & next steps

Hi Alex / Sara —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Integration status: you’ve finished initial ingestion and have a working inference path; front-end team is validating latency.
- Pilot goals: validate accuracy on our 10k sample prompts, measure cost at production volumes, and validate end-to-end latency under 95th percentile SLA.
- From our discussion, estimated pilot volume is ~3M tokens/day (peak 5M/day). You shared a target budget of ~$10k–$15k/month and a target unit economics of roughly $110 / 1M tokens.

Next steps / asks:
1) Can you confirm expected daily volume for the next 2 weeks so we can size credits?
2) Would a 2-week trial extension help you complete the integration tests? If yes, what amount of trial credits (tokens) would you need?
3) If you confirm volumes, we’ll request a short credit approval internally and assign them to the pilot.

I’ve attached a short post-call notes doc and the onboarding checklist for your team.

Thanks — looking forward to the numbers.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: post_call_notes.docx (docx)

From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits extension & next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. Confirming the numbers from our side:
- Expected pilot consumption: ~3M tokens/day average, spikes up to ~5M/day during heavy testing.
- Budget signal: we’re targeting roughly $10k–$15k/month if the model meets quality goals.
- Target unit price: we’d like to get closer to ~$110 / 1M tokens (that’s our internal target for this eval).

A 2-week extension would be very helpful so we can finish the E2E tests and run the larger prompt set. Rough ask: 100,000,000 tokens of trial credit to cover the next 10–14 days of testing.

I’ve attached the integration plan the team will run through. Please let me know what you can approve.

—Alex
Alex Carter
Sr. Engineering Manager, AI Platform | Acme Corp
Attachment: integration_plan.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot credits extension & next steps — request for approval

Vivek / Michael —

Forwarding Alex’s note. Quick summary for approval:
- Customer: Acme Corp (deal ACME-2026-PILOT-57)
- Requested trial credits: 100,000,000 tokens for a 2-week extension to finish E2E integration and larger-scale prompt tests.
- Expected pilot burn: ~3M tokens/day (est) — total ~42M over 14 days; customer asked for 100M to provide headroom for spikes.
- Budget signal: they plan for $10k–$15k/month post-pilot; target $/1M tokens ~ $110.

Unit economics note: at $110 / 1M tokens, 100M credits ≈ $11,000 list-value. We typically approve up to $15k in pilot credits without exec signoff for ACME-size pilots.

Can you confirm approval for 100M trial credits and set an expiration date of 2026-10-24 (two weeks from today)? If approved, I’ll notify the customer and assign credits to the HubSpot deal.

Thanks — Marissa
Attachment: (none)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot credits extension & next steps — request for approval

Marissa —

Approved: authorize 100,000,000 trial tokens for ACME-2026-PILOT-57. Please set expiration to 2026-10-24 and log the credit in HubSpot under the deal record (link below).

Notes for accounting: mark as promotional pilot credit, non-billable, one-time. Finance (Michael) please confirm downstream entries.

I’ve attached the signed approval memo.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

Hi Alex / Sara —

Good news: we’ve approved 100,000,000 trial tokens for ACME-2026-PILOT-57. Expiration: 2026-10-24.

What I’ve done:
- Assigned the 100M trial credits to the HubSpot deal (link below).
- Attached the onboarding checklist and redemption instructions — you’ll see credentials and how to monitor usage in the Console.
- We’ll check in mid-pilot (one week) to review burn rate and any configuration tweaks (batching / quantization suggestions).

Please confirm once you see the credits in your Console and share the first-day usage numbers.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approved: Pilot credits assigned (100M) — burn-rate update

Marissa —

Thanks — we see the 100M credits and started ramping tests. Quick burn-rate update after the first four days:
- Total used so far: 35,000,000 tokens.
- Daily average over first 4 days: ~8.75M tokens/day (we had a 12M spike on day 2).
- Projection for next 10 days (if this pattern holds): additional ~87.5M tokens, which would put us very close to the 100M cap near the middle of the extension window.

Can you a) extend credits if needed or b) advise on immediate cost-reduction levers we should try (we are looking at batching and a lower-precision quantized runtime)? Any suggestions you can push now would help avoid an early cutoff.

I’ve attached the pilot_usage.csv with daily breakdown.

—Alex
Attachment: pilot_usage.csv (csv)
